recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5564 unless the work group later chooses to reformat the HTTP summary tables for unrelated reasons.
issue_request: FHIR-5564 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking the FHIR-core HTTP/REST summary table to treat the Accept header as optional for PUT, POST, and DELETE instead of N/A, because those interactions can return OperationOutcome responses in XML or JSON.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied before final Jira resolution. Jira comments say "already applied", and git commit 8ae7ef29bea3aded54acb531d872a1532a89a5ca removed the old per-interaction Accept column with N/A values for update/create/delete and added the note that all requests may include an optional Accept header, even DELETE.
additional_context: The current build-scope source page is source/http.html, the core RESTful API narrative page. Later refactors preserved the same semantics: the request summary no longer has an Accept column, the notes define N/A/R/O only for the remaining columns, and the response table still documents optional response bodies including OperationOutcome for delete interactions. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source file was edited because the current source already satisfies the requested semantic change.
